What's a program in the AUR that I've never used, but should?

Alright, so it is called "lighthouse." It is sort of a quick launch bar. You can get it in the AUR, it is called lighthouse-git. Install it, then copy the files from /usr/share/lighthouse to your ~/.config/lighthouse/

After thats done, go ahead and type "lighthouse | sh" in your terminal. It should just pop right up. try it out, launch an application or two.

After you confirm it is all working, go ahead and make a keybinding to open it up. Because I use OpenBox and SpectrWM as my primary X11 environments, I decided to use xbindkeys.

xbindkeys is really easy to work. Just install it from the main repositorys, and type "touch ~/.xbindkeysrc" and "xbindkeys -defaults > ~/.xbindkeysrc." after that, you should open up your xbindkeysrc in your favorite text editor, and there will be a whole load of templates for you to choose from to launch your application. Mine looks like this":

lighthouse quick launch bar

"lighthouse | sh"

control + semicolon

After that, add xbindkeys to your xinitrc or autostart file, whatever you use to autostart applications, and you are done!
